Pujo Go Privacy Policy

Last updated: 1 October 2026

Pujo Go helps you discover Durga Pujo pandals, plan your visits, explore with your team, earn Aura, and enjoy offers from participating brands. This policy explains what information we collect, why we use it, who can receive it, and the choices available to you.

Your privacy at a glance

  • Location is collected while you use the app. With your permission, we use your device location for features such as nearby discovery and check-ins. We do not collect your device location while the app is closed.
  • Visit information is limited to your team. Your pandal visits may be visible to your team members, not to users outside your team. Other users can see your total Aura collected across all sources, without a breakdown showing how much came from pandal visits or any other source.
  • Sharing your location with teammates is optional. You must opt in and choose the team members you want to share your location with. Joining a team or allowing device location access does not, by itself, enable location sharing.
  • Brands may receive anonymous statistics. For example, we may report that a pandal recorded 100 visits during a period, without identifying the visitors or sharing their individual visit histories.
  • Redeeming a coupon is a separate interaction. The participating brand receives the details needed to validate and fulfil that coupon. Those details are not treated as anonymous statistics.
  • We do not sell your personal information. We share personal information only for the purposes explained in this policy. Anonymous reporting is subject to the safeguards below.
  • You can make privacy requests. Contact support@pujogo.in to ask about your information, request a correction or deletion, or raise a concern.

1. Who is responsible for your information?

Pujo Go is operated by the Pujo Go team, the individual creators who collectively run the service. In this policy, "we", "us", and "our" refer to that team. We are responsible for how personal information is handled through the Pujo Go app and related services covered by this policy.

Personal information means information that identifies you or can reasonably be linked to you. This includes information associated with your account or device, even if your real name is absent. A guest identifier, a coupon assigned to your account, or a visit history associated with a user code can therefore still be personal information.

Our privacy contact is support@pujogo.in.

2. What information do we collect, and why?

The information we collect depends on the features you use, the permissions you allow, and what you choose to submit.

Your account and profile

We collect account identifiers, your display name, username, email address, and sign-in information. For password-based accounts, we store a password hash rather than a readable copy of your password. We also keep account creation and update dates, recent activity times, account type, and visibility preferences.

You may add a profile photograph, banner image, biography, and social links. We use these details to maintain your account, present your profile, associate contributions with you, and support account recovery.

Guest accounts also have identifiers. Activity and rewards can be associated with a guest account and may become part of your registered account if you later register it. Guest use does not mean that no information is collected or that all activity is anonymous.

Location and pandal visits

When you permit location access and use a relevant feature, we process the location provided by your device, including precise latitude and longitude and the reported location accuracy.

A check-in records your account, the pandal, and the time of the visit. We can also save the coordinates, accuracy, and device information submitted with it. We use these records to verify visits, maintain your own visit history, award Aura and bonuses, support team activities, and investigate duplicate or suspicious check-ins.

Location also supports maps, nearby suggestions, and route planning. We collect your device location only while you are using Pujo Go, subject to your device permissions. We do not collect it in the background when the app is closed.

Routes and favourites

We keep routes you create or save, including their names, descriptions, stops and order, estimated duration, cover images, tags, and visibility. We also record favourite pandals and routes, route comments and ratings, and whether a route was copied from a community route.

We use this information to save your plans, provide route features, and make routes available to others when you publish them.

Teams, Aura, and captures

We record the teams you join, create, or manage, your role, joining dates, and participation. Gameplay information includes Aura earned and spent, balances, contribution preferences, seasonal scores, rankings, pandal captures, capture times, contributions, and bonuses.

We use this information to coordinate team gameplay, apply capture and reward rules, maintain balances, and display your total Aura. Visibility to other users is limited as described in Section 3. Your Aura contribution preference controls how your Aura can be used in gameplay; it is not general consent to share your personal information.

Rewards and coupons

We record rewards granted to you, offers you unlock, unique coupon codes, claim dates, expiry information, and redemption status and time. Where you claim an advertisement-related bonus, we record whether it has been claimed.

These records let us check eligibility, issue and fulfil rewards, resolve reward problems, and prevent duplicate redemption.

Your content and contributions

We collect photographs, reviews, ratings, comments, event information, pandal proposals, location corrections, transit suggestions, and public-facility reports that you submit. We keep authorship, submission times, relevant editing history, review status, and feedback.

We use this information to provide community features, improve place information, and review contributions. Facility attributes, such as wheelchair accessibility, describe the place being reported on; you do not need to disclose your own health or disability to provide them.

Support and safety

When you request help or report a problem, we collect the information you provide, the relevant account or content, the reason for the report, and resolution notes. Support information may include your app version and device operating system.

We use this information to respond, investigate reports, protect users, and enforce service and gameplay rules.

Technical information and notifications

We process activity records, including actions, associated account identifiers, and timestamps. Technical records can include device and app information, connection or session details, IP addresses, error messages, and information associated with a failed request. Uploaded files can have associated information such as file type, size, ownership, and upload time.

We use this information to run and secure Pujo Go, diagnose problems, understand feature usage, and improve reliability. If you enable notifications, we use a device notification token to deliver relevant messages.

Brand representatives

If you manage a participating brand, we handle your relationship to it, business contact details, listing descriptions, outlet addresses and coordinates, images, offers, and partnership information. We use these details to administer the partnership and display the business information intended for visitors.

Service analysis and communications

We use relevant account and activity information to operate and improve Pujo Go, respond to you, deliver account and service notices, prevent misuse, and meet legal obligations. We may also use recorded visits and offer activity to create anonymous statistical reports for the purposes described in Section 4.

Some processes operate automatically, including points calculations, rankings, reward eligibility, feature-use limits, and checks for duplicate or suspicious activity. If you believe a result affecting your account, check-in, or reward is incorrect, contact us for a review.

3. Who can see or receive personal information?

Aura totals visible to other users

The Aura information visible to other users is your total Aura collected across all sources. We do not show them a source-by-source breakdown or how much Aura you earned from pandal visits. Your total Aura does not give other users access to your check-in records or individual visit history.

Pandal visits within your team

Your pandal visits and check-in status may be visible to members of your team for team gameplay. We do not make this visit information visible to users outside your team. A teammate seeing that you checked in at a pandal is different from receiving your current device location.

Optional location sharing with selected team members

You can choose to share your device location with selected members of your team. This feature is opt-in: you decide whether to enable it and which team members receive your location. Joining a team, checking in at a pandal, or granting the app device location permission does not, by itself, enable this sharing.

You can stop sharing your location or change whom you share it with through the location-sharing controls. Stopping sharing prevents further location updates through this feature; it cannot remove information a recipient has already seen or independently saved. We collect your device location only while you use the app, subject to your device permissions, and do not collect it while the app is closed.

Content you choose to publish

Separately from your visit records and Aura, content you choose to publish through community features, such as reviews, photographs, comments, or public routes, can be seen by others. A route or photograph you publish may reveal a place you have visited; publishing it does not give others access to your saved check-in history. Consider what your chosen content reveals before publishing it. Other people may save or copy public content, and changing its visibility does not retrieve those copies.

A brand when you redeem its offer

When you unlock a coupon, we associate it with your account. When you present it to the participating brand, the brand can receive the details needed to validate and fulfil the offer, such as its code, offer details, validity, redemption status, and redemption confirmation or time.

These details relate to a particular redemption and are not anonymous statistics. Presenting a coupon in person may also allow the brand to associate that redemption with you.

Redemption does not itself authorise us to give the brand your email address, private profile information, or other pandal visit records for its own marketing. If you separately provide details to a business for an order, mailing list, or review, its own privacy notice applies to that interaction.

Providers that help run Pujo Go

We use providers for functions such as hosting, data storage, maps and routing, notifications, and technical support. They may process personal information needed to perform those functions. A routing provider, for example, may need the locations or stops in your request, while a notification provider needs information that enables delivery to your device.

This operational processing is different from giving a sponsor access to your personal visit records. The anonymous-reporting limits in Section 4 do not mean that every provider needed to operate the app receives only anonymous information.

Legal requirements and protection

We may disclose relevant information where reasonably necessary to comply with law or a valid legal request, investigate fraud or misuse, protect someone's safety, or establish or defend legal claims.

A change in who operates Pujo Go

If the service's ownership or operation changes, relevant information may be transferred as part of that change, subject to applicable protections and notice requirements. Such a change does not itself authorise unrelated uses of your personal information.

We do not sell your personal information. The sharing described here is limited to the purposes set out in this policy.

4. Anonymous statistics and brand partnerships

What we may report

We may combine recorded pandal visits, check-ins, and offer activity into anonymous summaries and share them with participating brands or brands considering a partnership with Pujo Go.

Examples include:

  • The total check-ins recorded for a particular pandal during a stated period.
  • The number of distinct Pujo Go accounts that checked in to a pandal during that period.
  • Broad comparisons of recorded activity across pandals, areas, or festival periods, where the level of detail protects individuals.
  • Total coupon unlocks or redemptions for an offer or participating brand.

For example, a report could state: "Pandal A recorded 100 check-ins through Pujo Go during the festival period." It would not include a list identifying who checked in.

Recorded check-ins and distinct accounts are different measures. These reports describe activity recorded through Pujo Go, not everyone who physically attended a pandal. A count of distinct accounts is not necessarily a verified count of individual people.

Why we share these summaries

The summaries can help us and prospective or participating brands understand overall festival activity, plan partnerships and offers, decide where services may be useful, and assess offer performance. They can support commercial partnerships without providing personal visitor lists.

What anonymous reporting excludes

We will share a report as anonymous only where it cannot reasonably identify you or reveal your individual activity, including when considered alongside other reasonably available information.

These reports will not include your name, contact details, account or device identifiers, hashed user identifiers, profile images, coupon codes, precise device coordinates, individual check-in times, or personal visit history. A pandal's name or location can appear in a report about that place; this is different from sharing a person's location trail.

How we protect against identification

Before sharing, we will reduce detail, combine groups, or withhold figures where small numbers or detailed breakdowns could single someone out. We will also consider whether comparing reports or combining them with other information could reveal an individual's activity.

Removing a name or replacing it with a code is not enough. If information remains linked or reasonably linkable to you, we treat it as personal information rather than anonymous statistics.

We will require brand recipients to use the summaries for aggregate analysis and not attempt to identify visitors or link the reports to identifiable customer records. If a summary cannot meet these privacy limits, we will not share it under this anonymous-reporting provision.

The underlying account-linked check-in and reward records remain personal information. Creating an anonymous report does not remove the protections that apply to those original records.

If partnerships change

As partnerships develop, the reports offered may vary within the purposes and privacy limits above. This policy does not give brands general access to your account, identifiable visit records, or information for contacting or targeting you individually.

If a future feature would involve different information, recipients, or purposes, we will explain the proposed use before it begins, update this policy, and obtain your consent where required. Redeeming an offer or continuing to use Pujo Go does not by itself give a brand permission for unrelated personal-data marketing.

5. Your permissions and choices

Location

You can review, limit, or revoke location access in your device settings. Where available, you can select approximate or precise location and restrict access to when you use the app.

Precise location may be needed to verify a pandal visit. Without sufficient location access or accuracy, nearby suggestions, navigation, check-ins, and associated rewards may not work as expected.

Revoking permission stops access through that permission. It does not erase location information already saved; you can request its removal using the process below.

Device location permission and sharing your location with team members are separate choices. You can use location-based features without opting in to share your location with teammates. If you opt in, you choose the recipients and can stop sharing through the location-sharing controls.

Photos, notifications, and public activity

You can manage camera, photo-access, and notification permissions through your device settings. Camera or photo access relates to features where you choose to take or submit an image. Turning a permission off may limit the relevant feature without deleting previously submitted information.

You can edit your profile, omit optional details, choose which content to publish, and use the available route visibility controls. You can also stop participating in optional team, community, or reward features.

Consent

Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it using the relevant control or by contacting support@pujogo.in. Withdrawal applies to future processing based on that consent and does not undo earlier lawful processing. If information is necessary to provide a feature, withdrawing consent may prevent us from continuing to provide that feature.

Reading this policy or signing in does not itself grant permission for every optional use of your information. We seek any separate permissions or consent required for the relevant use.

6. Security

We use reasonable safeguards intended to protect personal information from unauthorised access, loss, misuse, and alteration. These include measures relating to account access, password protection, and secure transmission.

No service can guarantee absolute security. Keep sign-in credentials and unused coupon codes private, and contact us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. Where a personal information breach requires notice under applicable law, we will notify affected people and the relevant authorities as required.

7. Retention and anonymous records

We keep personal information for as long as reasonably necessary to provide the service and fulfil the purposes described here, including maintaining your account and history, administering rewards, resolving requests and disputes, protecting the service, and meeting legal requirements.

An expired coupon or completed Pujo season does not automatically remove its history. Retention depends on the information, why it is needed, and any legal requirement to keep it.

When personal information is no longer needed and no legal reason requires its retention, we delete it or anonymise it so it cannot reasonably be linked to you. Merely removing a name or account reference does not, by itself, make the remaining information anonymous.

Anonymous statistics that can no longer reasonably be linked to you may be retained and used for the reporting purposes in Section 4. Because such statistics do not identify whose activity contributed to them, an account-deletion request does not necessarily remove a contribution from a genuinely anonymous total. This does not justify retaining your identifiable source records after they are no longer needed.

Hiding content or making it private is different from deleting it. Information hidden from public view may remain stored. Information retained after account closure remains subject to the protections that apply to it under this policy.

8. Access, correction, deletion, and complaints

You can contact support@pujogo.in to:

  • Ask what personal information we hold and how it is used or shared.
  • Request access to your information or correction of inaccurate or incomplete details.
  • Request deletion of your account or particular personal information.
  • Withdraw consent for processing that depends on it.
  • Raise a privacy concern, including a concern about public visibility or a report that you believe identifies someone.

Include your Pujo Go username and, where possible, write from the email address associated with your account. We may ask for information reasonably necessary to verify your request. Do not send your password or a one-time sign-in code.

Account deletion

Email us with the subject "Account Deletion Request" and include your username. You can also consult our Account & Data Deletion page. If you use a guest account or cannot access your registered email, contact us for help identifying the account.

We aim to process and confirm account deletion within 15 business days, subject to verifying the request and any legal requirement to retain particular information. If more information or time is needed, we will explain why.

Deletion removes access to the account and can affect saved routes, team participation, Aura, and unredeemed rewards. Uninstalling the app, signing out, or clearing local app data does not itself delete information held by Pujo Go.

Some shared records, such as pandal information, contributed photographs, or completed transactions, may remain where there is a lawful reason to retain them. Your request also covers identifying details associated with those records; we will explain any personal information that must remain and why. We cannot directly retrieve copies independently made by other users or businesses.

Privacy complaints and legal rights

Use "Privacy Request" or "Privacy Complaint" as your email subject and describe the issue. We will review it and respond within the period required by applicable law.

Your statutory rights depend on the law applicable to your request and the provisions in force at the time. Where applicable, they can include information about processing and disclosures, correction and erasure, grievance redressal, and nomination of someone to exercise rights on your behalf. Nothing in this policy limits those rights. If you remain dissatisfied, you may use the complaint or other remedies available under applicable law.

9. Where information is processed

Information may be processed in India and in other countries where our providers operate. International processing remains subject to the protections and transfer restrictions required by applicable law. Contact us if you have questions about where or how your information is handled.

10. Children and younger users

Pujo Go allows users under 18 but is not directed to children under 13. If you are under 18, ask your parent or lawful guardian to review this policy with you before using the service or sharing personal information. Pay particular attention to location permissions, optional location sharing with selected team members, and any content you choose to publish.

Where applicable law requires a parent's or guardian's verifiable consent, that consent is required before we process the child's personal information. A store age rating is not parental consent. Restrictions on children's tracking, behavioural monitoring, and targeted advertising apply where required by law. Calling a report anonymous does not remove requirements that apply when collecting or using a child's underlying personal information.

Parents or guardians who believe a child's information has been collected or shared inappropriately can contact support@pujogo.in. We will review the concern and take appropriate steps, including deletion where required.

11. External services and advertisements

Pujo Go may display externally supplied maps or advertisements and link to business websites, review pages, social profiles, and other services. These features can involve direct connections to their providers, which may receive technical information such as your IP address, device or browser information, and details about your request or interaction.

Information you provide directly to another service, or that it handles for its own purposes, is governed by its privacy notice. For Google services used through Pujo Go, you can read the Google Privacy Policy.

The anonymous brand-reporting described in Section 4 does not describe every external-service interaction. Please review the relevant notice before sharing additional information with another service.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when Pujo Go's features, partnerships, practices, or legal obligations change. The date at the top shows when it was last updated.

We will make the updated policy available through the app or website and provide notice of material changes before they take effect where required. A policy update is not a substitute for consent where consent is needed for a new use or disclosure of personal information.

13. Contact us

Pujo Go team — Privacy Support
Email: support@pujogo.in
Website: www.pujogo.in

Pujo Go Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 1 October 2026

Welcome to Pujo Go. These Terms & Conditions explain the rules for using our app and related services to discover Durga Pujo pandals, plan routes, participate in team gameplay, earn Aura, and access participating brands' offers.

Pujo Go is operated by the Pujo Go team, the individual creators who collectively run the service. In these terms, “Pujo Go”, “we”, “us”, and “our” refer to that team. “You” refers to the person using the service or, where applicable, the parent or lawful guardian agreeing to these terms for a younger user.

For questions or support, contact support@pujogo.in.

1. Agreeing to these terms

Please read these terms before using Pujo Go. By accepting them when prompted, you agree to follow them. If you do not agree, do not proceed with using the service.

An offer, event, or gameplay feature may have additional conditions displayed with it. Those conditions apply to that particular offer, event, or feature and must be available before you participate. They do not override rights that applicable law gives you.

Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle personal information. Accepting these terms is not consent to every optional use of your data. Location permissions, sharing your location with teammates, and other uses requiring separate consent remain separate choices.

2. Who can use Pujo Go

You must have the legal capacity to agree to these terms. Pujo Go allows users under 18 but is not directed to children under 13. If you are under 18, a parent or lawful guardian must review and agree to these terms for your use and provide any consent required by law. You must use the app with their permission and appropriate supervision.

If you are that parent or guardian, please help the younger user understand safe exploration, team participation, location sharing, and offer conditions. A younger user's acceptance alone does not replace parental or guardian agreement or any legally required consent. These terms do not impose an enforceable contractual obligation on a child where the law does not allow it.

Some offers may have their own lawful age or eligibility restrictions. Do not claim an offer for which you are ineligible.

3. Your account

Provide accurate information when creating or maintaining your account. Do not impersonate another person, use another person's account without permission, or create accounts to evade restrictions or claim duplicate benefits.

Keep your sign-in credentials and unused coupon codes secure. Tell us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access. You are responsible for your own use of the account and for protecting access to it; you are not automatically responsible for activity caused by a failure on our part.

Guest access, where available, may have limited recovery options. Signing out, changing devices, or removing app data may affect your ability to recover a guest account. Contact support if you lose access; we may need information to verify that the account is yours.

You must not sell, rent, or trade accounts or use them to manipulate gameplay or rewards.

4. Exploring safely and respectfully

Pujo Go provides discovery and planning information. Pandal locations, routes, metro information, public toilets, water points, business listings, opening hours, and other map details may be incomplete, delayed, or inaccurate. A suggested route does not guarantee that a path is open, accessible, safe, or permitted.

Always follow current instructions from police, transport authorities, organisers, property owners, and emergency services. Respect queues, crowd controls, road closures, entry restrictions, accessibility requirements, and local customs. Do not trespass, enter restricted areas, obstruct others, or disturb worship or festivities to complete an app activity.

Stay aware of your surroundings. Do not interact with the app while driving or crossing roads. Stop in a safe place before checking the map or playing. A check-in, reward, or capture is never a reason to enter an unsafe place or ignore an instruction to leave.

Pujo Go is not an emergency service, a live crowd-safety system, or a guarantee of someone's whereabouts. Location sharing may be delayed or interrupted and must not be relied on for emergency monitoring.

5. Check-ins and Aura

Aura is an in-app points system. Eligible activities may earn Aura under the rules shown for the relevant feature or season. Visiting a place does not automatically guarantee points: a check-in may require location permission, sufficient accuracy, a valid account, and successful verification. Repeat-visit limits or other eligibility conditions may apply.

Your total Aura earned and your available Aura balance may differ, for example after spending points in gameplay. An offer may require an Aura threshold, a deduction of Aura, or another qualifying action. Check the displayed conditions before participating; meeting a threshold does not, by itself, mean that points are deducted.

Aura is not money, a bank balance, a deposit, an investment, or a claim to ownership in Pujo Go. It has no cash-redemption value and cannot be sold or transferred outside features expressly provided by the app. An advertised coupon or discount may still have the benefit described in that offer.

Points, bonuses, and progress depend on the applicable rules and verified activity. We may correct duplicate awards, calculation errors, or rewards obtained through abuse. If you believe a correction or rejected check-in is wrong, contact us for review.

Season dates, expiry rules, resets, and any changes affecting how Aura is earned or used will be explained in the relevant feature or notice. We will not treat these terms as permission to apply undisclosed expiry conditions retrospectively. Changes remain subject to applicable law and commitments already made for validly claimed rewards.

6. Teams and pandal captures

You may join or create a team and participate in shared gameplay where available. Treat teammates and other visitors respectfully. Team roles and contribution settings govern the actions available within the app; they do not let one member give privacy consent for another.

A pandal “capture” is a temporary in-app game status. It gives no ownership of, control over, exclusive access to, or authority over the physical pandal, its organisers, or other visitors. It does not represent an endorsement by the pandal or its organisers.

Captures may require eligible check-ins and contributions of Aura. Before initiating a capture or enabling automatic contributions, review the applicable spending rules and your contribution settings. When you enable automatic contributions, eligible team actions may use Aura within those settings without asking you to approve each contribution separately. An initiator may need to cover a shortfall under the applicable gameplay rules.

You can change the available contribution settings for future actions. Changing a setting or leaving a team does not automatically reverse contributions already completed. Losing a capture or the end of its holding period does not itself entitle you to restoration of spent Aura. Contact us if a deduction appears incorrect or unauthorised.

Other teams may capture the same pandal when the rules permit. We do not promise a particular holding period, ranking, outcome, or reward beyond the conditions stated for that feature.

7. Team visibility and optional location sharing

Your pandal visits and check-in status may be visible to your team members, not to users outside your team. Other users can see your total Aura collected across all sources, without a breakdown showing how much came from pandal visits or another source.

Sharing your device location with teammates is optional. You must opt in and select the team members you want to receive it. Joining a team, checking in, or granting device location permission does not by itself enable location sharing. You can stop sharing or change recipients through the location-sharing controls.

We collect device location only while you use the app, subject to device permissions, and do not collect it while the app is closed. Stopping sharing prevents further updates through that feature but cannot retrieve information someone has already seen or saved.

Use information shared by teammates only for its intended purpose. Do not use it to stalk, harass, monitor someone against their wishes, or disclose their whereabouts without permission. Our Privacy Policy provides further details about personal information and your choices.

8. Brand offers, coupons, and rewards

Offers depend on participating brands and availability. Before unlocking or redeeming one, read its conditions, including any qualifying Aura, participating outlets, validity dates, stock limits, minimum spend, excluded items, usage limits, or restrictions on combining discounts. A reward may be valid during Pujo, after Pujo, or both, as specified in its terms.

Unlocking a coupon and redeeming it are separate steps. A coupon must be used through the stated process and within its validity period. Unless expressly permitted, you must not sell, duplicate, transfer, alter, or reuse a coupon, or attempt to redeem it more times than allowed.

A coupon does not guarantee admission, a reservation, stock, or immediate service unless the offer expressly includes that benefit. Any required payment to a business, including applicable charges, is governed by the disclosed purchase and offer conditions. Check the final amount before paying.

The participating business is responsible for the goods or services it supplies, including their quality, safety, billing, and its applicable return or refund obligations. Pujo Go remains responsible for its own service and commitments. A listing or advertisement is not a guarantee of every statement made by that business.

If a valid coupon is refused, marked redeemed incorrectly, or cannot be used because of an app error, contact us with the offer details and relevant evidence. Do not send passwords or publish an unused coupon code. We will review issues involving our service and, where appropriate, coordinate with the participating brand. Available remedies depend on the circumstances, the offer, and applicable law; these terms do not remove rights to a refund or another remedy where legally required.

Offers may end or become unavailable under their disclosed conditions. Changes to future offers do not automatically cancel commitments attached to an offer you have already validly claimed.

9. Fair play and acceptable use

You must not:

  • Falsify check-ins, spoof location to obtain benefits, use bots, or manipulate account, capture, points, or redemption records.
  • Exploit a vulnerability, bypass access controls, disrupt the service, or access another person's information without authorisation.
  • Use multiple accounts, scripts, or coordinated activity to evade limits or obtain benefits dishonestly.
  • Harass, threaten, discriminate against, impersonate, or expose private information about another person.
  • Submit unlawful, fraudulent, hateful, sexually exploitative, or rights-infringing content, or upload malicious code or spam.
  • Misrepresent a business, pandal, facility, review, or affiliation, or use Pujo Go to facilitate unlawful conduct.

Report suspected errors or vulnerabilities privately to support@pujogo.in. Do not access other users' data or disrupt the service to demonstrate a problem.

10. Content you contribute

You remain the owner of content you submit, such as photographs, reviews, comments, routes, or corrections, to the extent you own the relevant rights. Submit only material you have the right to share. Respect photography restrictions, other people's privacy, and intellectual property rights. Reviews should reflect your genuine experience, and contributions should not knowingly mislead others.

You give us a non-exclusive, royalty-free permission to store, reproduce, format, display, and distribute your submitted content as needed to operate the features you use, review contributions, and make your chosen public contributions available. This permission is limited to those purposes and allows our service providers to help perform them. It does not transfer ownership or give us unrestricted permission to use your identity or content in unrelated advertising.

Public content may be viewed, saved, or copied by others. You can use available editing or removal controls or contact support. After removal, we will stop making that content available through the relevant feature, subject to necessary processing time and any lawful retention described in our Privacy Policy. Copies independently made by others may remain outside our control.

We may review, decline, correct, or remove contributions that are unlawful, inaccurate, abusive, infringe rights, or breach these terms. We do not guarantee publication or pre-screen every contribution. Report concerns with enough information for us to identify and review the content.

11. Pujo Go materials and external services

We and the relevant rights holders retain rights in the app, software, design, branding, and other materials, apart from your own contributions. You may use the service for its intended personal and community purposes in accordance with these terms. You must not copy or commercially exploit protected materials without permission, except where the law permits it.

Pandal names, business names, logos, maps, and other third-party materials belong to their respective rights holders. Their appearance in the app does not necessarily indicate sponsorship, endorsement, or an official association.

External websites, maps, advertisements, and services may have their own terms and privacy notices. Review them before providing information or making a purchase. We are responsible for our own representations and conduct, but do not control independent services merely because the app links to them.

12. Availability and changes to the service

Features may depend on connectivity, GPS accuracy, your device, permissions, third-party services, and seasonal availability. We aim to keep Pujo Go useful and reliable but cannot promise uninterrupted operation, error-free information, or availability of every feature or offer at all times.

We may maintain, update, restrict, or discontinue features for reasons such as safety, security, legal requirements, technical needs, or changes to the service. Where a planned material change affects your use or existing benefits, we will provide reasonable notice where practicable and explain relevant effects. Urgent security or legal action may need to happen immediately.

If we discontinue a feature or the service, we will address outstanding commitments according to their disclosed conditions and applicable law. This section does not permit us to disregard valid claims or legal obligations.

13. Restrictions, suspension, and ending use

We may restrict a feature, remove content, reverse improperly obtained benefits, or suspend or close an account where reasonably necessary to address a breach of these terms, fraud, safety risks, unlawful activity, or a legal requirement. Account Deletion Policy

Your data, your control. Right to be forgotten.

Last Updated: 13 September 2025

This page outlines the process for requesting the deletion of your account and associated data from the Pujo Go mobile application, in compliance with Google Play Store policies. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have control over your personal information.

How to Request Account Deletion

To permanently delete your Pujo Go account and associated data, please follow these steps:

  1. Compose an email from the email address registered with your Pujo Go account.
  2. Send the email to: support@pujogo.in
  3. Use the subject line: "Account Deletion Request"
  4. In the body of the email, please include your Pujo Go username to help us verify your identity and locate your account.

Once we receive your request, our team will process it and confirm the deletion via email within 15 business days.

What Data is Deleted?

Upon the successful processing of your deletion request, the following data will be permanently and irreversibly deleted from our production servers:

  • ✓ Personal Profile Information: Your Name, userid, registered email address, and profile picture.
  • ✓ Activity & Game Data: Your entire check-in history at pandals, earned Aura Points, leaderboard rankings, and all unlocked badges or achievements.

What Data is Retained or Anonymized?

To maintain the integrity and functionality of the community features for other users, some data you created will be retained but fully anonymized. This means it will be completely disconnected from your identity.

  • User-Generated Content (UGC): Any Community Routes you created, along with their ratings and comments, will be preserved. However, all personal attribution will be removed and reassigned to an "Anonymous User" profile. This ensures that valuable community routes remain accessible to everyone without compromising your privacy.
  • Analytics Data: We may retain aggregated, non-personally identifiable analytical data for statistical purposes to understand user trends and improve the app. This data cannot be traced back to any individual user.

Data Retention Period

After your account data is deleted from our live systems, it may persist in our secure, encrypted backup systems for an additional period of up to 30 days. This is a standard security practice to ensure disaster recovery. After this period, the data is permanently purged from all backups.

Questions?

If you have any questions about this policy or our data practices, please do not hesitate to contact us at support@pujogo.in.
